scope: R29/UX16 commercial landing in an isolated worktree; author validation only, independent QA/security pending
mounted_route: GET / in web/routes/pages.py::index renders web/templates/landing.html in both factories

offer.business: Fresh get_plan_catalog('web') filtered by audiencia=gym on every render; personal pro_usuario is excluded
offer.personal: Fresh get_individual_plan_catalog() on every render; Starter/Pro kept separate from business
offer.prices: precio_centavos, moneda and periodo rendered from those functions; no copied product price/limit snapshot, new price, tax decision or trial duration
offer.limits: Active clients, new client registrations/day, plans per client/day, total business plans/day and monthly plans displayed together; zero means no cap in that one catalog dimension, never unlimited global capacity
offer.free: 10 active clients,1 plan/client/day,10 total/day and20/month from the current catalog; existing creation cap also displayed
offer.desktop: Continued support stated; web links do not promise an installer or subscription transfer

changes: Replace the public access selector with audience CTAs, connected offer, example, native FAQ, factual personal-data section and recurrent access links
Remove global unlimited/speed/five-minute setup,100-percent personalization, retention-report and absolute privacy promises
Keep clinical suitability outside the commercial promise; Clinica remains only the canonical plan name
Public landing has no script, credential/Storage read, automatic account redirect, private-data fetch or write request
Use an isolated stylesheet with a server-computed content version so both factories load the current asset without depending on shared template globals

Correct only registration mode initialization: selected type, active button and login link now agree for gym/usuario; absent or invalid type keeps the existing personal default. Submit/auth/Storage code is unchanged.

retired_orphan.reason: No runtime route or reference served this duplicate; only that copy was removed. web/pages/checkout.html and other neighbors are unchanged.
retired_orphan.provenance: before-source.json records SHA256, original Git blob and exact RAW copy outside the deliverable in a dedicated Temp directory. The obsolete page body is not copied into active product files.

example.execution: Real ASGI registration as VIEWER, profile update, individual quota reservation, worker, private object publication and authorized exact PDF in own temporary SQLite/local storage. Welcome delivery is replaced with an explicit no-send boundary; external sockets are blocked before product imports.
example.excerpt: First breakfast option in each of three macro groups copied without changing values; verified against the complete generated plan JSON. UI labels it demonstration data and not a nutritional recommendation or clinical evaluation.
example.proof: worker-example/generated-plan.json, generated-plan.pdf.zip (exact PDF entry) and provenance.json
example.reproducibility_limit: This reproduces the complete generation procedure. New synthetic identities and generated PDF metadata can change bytes; the committed excerpt is matched to its preserved actual worker result, not asserted to be a universal deterministic sample. No generation runs on public GET.
example.pdf_storage: Original RAW PDF preserved inside ZIP to prevent Git text/CRLF conversion of its ASCII85 body and byte-offset table. Original byte copy also retained outside the deliverable.

validation.before_http: Two red tests: both factories lacked the catalog offer. Raw active source archive and desktop/mobile screenshots preserved.
validation.before_browser: Original mounted selector had unsupported claims and personal/registration CTA below the initial mobile viewport.
validation.registration_red: First browser stage found the existing personal registration login link pointing to login-gym. Exact executed driver and source snapshot preserved before the approved one-line fix.
validation.harness_note: A later author probe failed because innerText omits closed native FAQ content. Its report/body remain preserved; the final harness opens the desktop FAQ before asserting visible support text. Product copy did not change for that correction.
validation.http_final: 12 passed across web.main_web and api.app; all prices/limits/currency/periods, exact links, runtime catalog mutations, sample extraction, no DML and no public credential dependencies
validation.browser_final: 8 groups,4 screenshots;1440/390/320 and keyboard-open FAQ,0 full-document axe AA findings,0 overflow,0 pageerrors; all6 offers checked against the canonical Python module at run time; no registration/payment form submitted
validation.fixtures: Own loopback8781 and metadata-only SQLite; reported target from expected_head() and actual table count, not an executed migration
validation.node_environment: Existing locked dependencies read via execution/tests/e2e/node_modules; author used NODE_PATH and candidate Python through METODOBASE_TEST_PYTHON. QA can use its own install from the unchanged lock.

limits: No publication, contact, pilot or external delivery
No broad backend/browser regression or load benchmark
No api.js, R34, security headers, migration or catalog edits
No new legal/privacy policy or support SLA invented; a public contact channel was not configured in the reviewed routes
